title: React Context
description: Learn how to share data across components without prop drilling.

data.text: **Context** provides a way to pass data through the component tree without having to pass props down manually at every level. It solves the 'prop drilling' problem.
When you need to pass data through many intermediate components that don't use it, that's prop drilling. Context solves this by making data available to any descendant.

data.title: Prop Drilling
Create Context
Don't Overuse Context
data.text: Context is great for truly global data. For component-specific data, props are simpler. Overusing context makes components harder to reuse and test.

data.title: Key Takeaways
data.takeaway: Context is powerful for global state. Let's explore useContext in depth.
